Five Earlier Single-Player Games Added to Quiet Arcade

A dated archive of five games covered by an earlier announcement. The list is historical context, not the current Arcade catalog or a V2 feature statement.

By NoCharge·Reviewed by NoCharge·Published August 22, 2026·Updated November 24, 2026·2 min read

Historical note: The original August 2026 announcement covered five additions to an earlier NoCharge Arcade catalog. This article preserves that announcement’s subject; it should not be read as a current catalog count or release notice.

The five titles in the announcement

  • Klondike
  • FreeCell
  • Nonogram
  • Twenty Forty-Eight
  • Tile Garden

All five have current V2 Arcade pages, but the list is only a slice of today’s published directory. The source inventory now lists 28 Arcade game-detail routes. Open the current Arcade for the complete catalog and each game’s rules, controls, mode, and timing.

Keep the release history separate from current behavior

Older announcements and imported articles can describe features that are not part of V2. This archive does not establish that scores are saved, that a dashboard exists, or that a particular game mode is still available. Current product behavior belongs to the live V2 page and source inventory.

The current Privacy and Advertising Disclosure pages describe the V2 site; this historical announcement is not policy approval or cutover evidence.
